verdict.rationale: Raygun is an error-monitoring SaaS with a public API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents no sandbox or isolated test mode. The only testing surface, the Swagger UI "Try it out" runner, is explicitly noted to execute against the production API with a Personal Access Token, which is the opposite of the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
